data.narrative:
Type One Energy is a Series B nuclear energy company founded by David Anderson, Chris Hegna, and John Canik that has raised over $100M to date. The nuclear energy sector comp universe includes 3 public peers (OKLO, NNE, SMR) and 8 private companies, with notable private comparables including Valar Atomics, Helion, Oklo (pre-IPO data), X-Energy, and Nano Nuclear Energy.

Valuation was assessed using stage-progression methodology, the only applicable triangulation approach given data constraints. Using the $100M total raised as a proxy base value and applying a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical of Series B advancement yields an implied valuation of $190M. A peer-median approach was not viable; while 6 same-sector peers exist, insufficient data points met narrow filtering criteria (same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar valuation tier), making an all-sector median comparison unreliable.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $162M to $218M, centered on $190M. This range reflects a ±15% sensitivity band around the stage-progression result. Key uncertainties include the narrow methodological foundation—reliance on a single applicable method rather than triangulated consensus—and the absence of direct comparable multiples within Type One's immediate peer tier. Further data on comparable funding rounds and market multiples in advanced nuclear technology would strengthen conviction in this range.
